Name: Alternate Lady Sheba Portrait (East Scarp)
Author: HannahBug
Description:
Provides an edited portrait for Lady Sheba the cat from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]! : ) Uploaded with permission <3
This is just an image, no coding! Below is instructions on how to apply to file manually if you don't know how/where to do that

[b]Installation:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Navigate to Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > mods > East Scarp (or wherever you put your East Scarp folder)
[*]Navigate to [CP] East Scarp NPCs > assets > images
[*]Replace LadySheba_Portrait with the file of the same name from this mod
[*]Done! :3

[/list]
